utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Madam Registrar, please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is case number IT-04-74-T, the Prosecutor versus Jadranko Prlic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Today is Thursday, 29th of November. My greetings to all the people in the courtroom, the Prosecution representatives, the Defence counsel, and the accused. First, I shall give the floor to the registrar, good morning to her, and to all those who assist us. I need three IC numbers, don't I.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, list of Prosecution exhibits tendered through Witness Amor Masovic will become Exhibit IC 733. Pusic Defence additional request for the admission of documents tendered through Witness Masovic will become Exhibit IC 734. The list of Prosecution exhibits tendered through Witness BC will become Exhibit IC 735, under seal.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. The Trial Chamber is going to hand down two oral decisions. I shall try to be quick, but these are urgent decisions to be issued. First oral decision: On the 27th of November, 2007, the Prosecution filed a motion for admission of documents related to Witness EA. The Trial Chamber recalls that further to two decisions handed down on the 13th of July and on the 29th of November, 2006, the Prosecution is allowed to tender documents either through witnesses in court or by written motion related to a specific municipality or topic. The Trial Chamber notes that this motion does not meet the guidelines set forth by the Trial Chamber for admission of documentary evidence, in that it is not linked to a specific municipality or topic. Furthermore, the Prosecution has already filed two motions for admission of evidence linked to Witness EA: The first time in a written motion filed on the 5th of July, 2007, and the second time in an oral motion for admission of evidence through Witness EA on the 26th of November, 2007; the IC number being 00722. The evidence thus presented by the Prosecution with regard to Witness EA amounts to some 120 documents. Given that the Prosecution is under the obligation to select the most important documents and to tender them whilst meeting the guidelines, the Trial Chamber has decided to turn down or dismiss the motion. Second oral decision: It has to do with a deadline for filing Prosecution motions. The Trial Chamber requests the Prosecution to file any motion by the 10th of December, 2007. This will enable the Trial Chamber to rule in due time by the end of the Prosecution case scheduled on the 24th of January, 2008. So with regard to the second oral decision, as of the 10th of December, 2007, the Trial Chamber will no longer accept any new motion. Let us move into private session, please.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.48 p.m.,
